name: David Gardiner Tyler
bioAdditions: 6th cousin 5 times removed (son of Julia Gardiner Tyler, S2). Born in New York; Confederate soldier; studied in Germany and Virginia; Virginia State Senator, U.S. Representative (Va. 2nd district) and circuit judge (S1).
